papers.title: What Should SFT Learn? Conditional Information Gain for Generalizable Post-Training
papers.summary: Proposes CIG-SFT, which weights each demonstrated token by how much the task input reduces a frozen reference model's uncertainty about it, rather than by model compatibility. This yields an equivalent scalar-weighted SFT objective that needs no extra data or online rollouts. It outperforms standard and adaptive SFT baselines on math reasoning and code generation, especially out of distribution.

papers.title: Meta-Reflective Evolution Effectively Improves Production AI Systems
papers.summary: Introduces CoCoEvolve, an evolutionary optimizer whose agentic mutator retrieves evidence from the whole evolutionary history and probes the live system before proposing mutations (meta-reflection). It tops the DABStep leaderboard at 92.8% held-out hard accuracy versus 78.4% for Meta-Harness and 30.4% for GEPA. It also improves LLM data pipelines and data-engineering workflows, with ablations showing each component contributes.
